task: changepoint-detector flagship: a step-only known-date test with a control series, pre-registered, on fresh real pairs (state cigarette tax rises)

doc_friction.issue: The control round's simulation assumed the difference leaves AR(1) rho 0.4 noise; real state ratios wander (median rho 0.76), so its bars could not predict the real refusals. Future control rounds should calibrate the idiosyncratic noise on real pairs before setting bars.

writeups: ventures/changepoint-detector/README.md (The step alone, with a control series)
notes: Pre-registered (eval/known-date-prereg-control-step-2026-11-17.md, committed 224a479bf before the confirmatory runs). Simulation bars 1-4 held (size 4.3-6.8%, findings under bends 0-5.3%, power 65.5/60.8/24.0/40.0% vs joint 51.3/49.5/14.0/14.0%, false warnings 1.3-4.3%). Real bars 5a/5b failed: CA 1989, MA 1993, AZ 1995, OR 1997 all refused as wanders; 5c held (1 of 9 placebo states, TN). Nothing shipped; README, flagship next, test and post record the negative. New data: CDC Tax Burden on Tobacco 1970-2019 (ODC-BY 1.0) in data/. Verification: node --test known-date-control.test.mjs 5/5; run_venture_tests.py changepoint-detector (see PR); post front matter, links and similarity checks clean.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id

certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
